highlights.title: Prevent meals disappearing during carb edits
changes: Editing a carb entry now replaces the meal in a single operation.
Fat/protein edits now rebuild their carb-equivalents correctly.

includedPullRequests.title: fix: replace carb entry in a single transaction
includedPullRequests.body:
Fixes an issue when editing a carb entry: the entry could disappear (deleted but not recreated).
This change replaces the entries in a single transaction.

### Issue explanation:
`BaseCarbEntryMutationService.replaceMeal` still committed the delete and the insert as two independent Core Data transactions. The insert can fail silently, causing the meal to be completely removed. Similarly, a crash between delete and insert would do the same.

### Testing:
Tested on iPhone 15, iOS26 — the device we use for Trio.
First, put the device in a Faraday cage (tin can) for 30 minutes.
Then tried multiple meal edit cycles, simple and complex (fat/protein) meals. Also checked the records are updated on Nightscout properly.
